method: Direct visual inspection of 12 existing phone PNGs; independent SHA-256 calculation and binding to CAPTURES.json metadata. No device control, backend reads, UI dumps, or data mutations.
scope: Selected physical-phone captures of the owner side of the authorized single Test R18 journey. Static screenshots establish visible states and layout only; this is not full-app acceptance, a server-state audit, or an independent interaction replay.
limits: The worker-side rating and emulator actions were not independently reviewed in this phone-only batch.
No claim about network timing, animations, screen-reader behavior, offline/error states, all screen sizes, or complete store readiness.
Device metadata reports fontScale 1.15. Reviews preserve that context instead of treating the captures as default-font screenshots.
CAPTURES.json remains untouched. This sidecar does not replace the capture producer's execution receipts.

followups.observation: The first visible draft line is vertically clipped at the top of the multiline composer while the keyboard is open. The final draft line, Photos action, and send button remain visible above the keyboard.
followups.suggestion: Check multiline TextInput height, padding, and internal scrolling with fontScale 1.15. Keep the caret and complete current line visible without moving attachment/send controls into the keyboard.
followups.limit: A still image cannot establish whether internal input scrolling restores the hidden line; the clipping is visible in this captured position. Sending subsequently succeeds in the next reviewed capture.

followups.observation: New agreement success feedback appears below the long offer contents and is partly clipped at the bottom of the scroll viewport. The Open agreement button remains fully visible.
followups.suggestion: On successful selection, reveal the compact success confirmation or move focus/scroll to it while retaining access to accepted offer terms.
followups.limit: This is a visibility improvement, not evidence that selection or navigation failed.

images.visible_evidence: Published header; one person; offer-based price mode; Smartphone tool; flexible schedule; no photo; application deadline explanation; Open task action.
images.layout: Facts and pinned primary action are readable; the top content is partly outside the viewport in this scrolled capture. No primary-action overlap is visible.

images.visible_evidence: Applicant identity and reputation, total for one person, 100 RSD, flexible date range, full test offer message, and Choose this offer action.
images.layout: Rounded sheet separates applicant, accepted-price facts, and message. Main action is fully visible above the safe area; initials are a clear avatar fallback.

images.visible_evidence: Confirmation explains that one choice forms an Agreement and lists total 100 RSD, one person, and immediate consequence; confirm and cancel are visible.
images.layout: Consequence copy is long but readable; both decision controls remain visible. A stacked-sheet still does not prove transition quality.

images.visible_evidence: Same offer terms persist; Agreement formed message appears; Open Agreement is available.
images.layout: Success feedback is partly clipped below long offer contents, although navigation is unobstructed.

images.visible_evidence: Keyboard-open chat uses compact participant header and Terms action; initial empty state, refresh, draft, Photos, and send action are visible.
images.layout: Composer and send action stay above keyboard. The first draft line is vertically clipped within the input; last line is readable. Empty-state illustration occupies substantial space while typing.

images.visible_evidence: Outgoing Test R18 message is fully visible with time 22:42; draft has cleared; task identity and 100 RSD remain above the transcript.
images.layout: Outgoing bubble has clear contrast and wraps without truncating the message. Empty composer, Photos, and disabled send button are visible; no fabricated read-receipt mark is shown.

images.visible_evidence: Outgoing message remains and incoming Test R18 reply appears at 22:43; refresh action and empty composer remain accessible.
images.layout: Incoming and outgoing bubbles are clearly differentiated. Both complete messages and their timestamps fit above the composer in this capture.

images.visible_evidence: Status says completion is marked and awaits the owner's confirmation, with deadline and automatic-close explanation; 100 RSD total and Confirm completion action are visible.
images.layout: Status is prominent and the primary completion action stays pinned. The safety row begins below the viewport; no conclusion about its offscreen contents is made.

images.visible_evidence: Completion review explains the action and lists task, participant, no confirmed exact time, one person, 100 RSD total, and explicit Yes, confirm completion action.
images.layout: Accepted terms are readable and separated. The explicit confirmation button is fully visible above the safe area.

images.visible_evidence: Agreement completed status and invitation to rate; remote task title and 100 RSD total persist; Rate collaboration action is visible.
images.layout: Completion status has clear hierarchy and next action. Safety row extends behind the fixed footer in this scroll position but the rating action itself is unobstructed.

images.visible_evidence: Rating saved confirmation, correct recipient label, five stars, Your rating: 5 of 5, immutable-rating explanation, and Back to Agreement action.
images.layout: Success, recipient, and rating are visually distinct; all essential copy and the return action are visible without overlap. Only this owner's rating is evidenced here.

images.visible_evidence: Test R18 parent task is labelled Closed; no applications currently available for selection, one application total, one of one place filled, remote/flexible facts, and View applications action.
images.layout: Closed state is explicit at the top and the application count distinguishes historical total from selectable rows. Offer-based pricing remains labelled Seeking offers as the original pricing mode; it is not evidence that the closed task is accepting applications.
